content.value_statement: Data teams often struggle to turn technical capabilities into repeatable revenue. This skill structures positioning, offerings, revenue, partnerships, defensibility, and phased growth.
actual_capabilities: Compares data provider, technology service, consulting, platform, and DMaaS positioning options.
Designs a 1+4+N architecture linking one entry service, four extensions, and multiple industry scenarios.
Builds revenue mixes across projects, subscriptions, transactions, commissions, consulting, and technology services.
Structures product portfolios with entry, profit, and strategic offerings.
Designs membership tiers, partner channels, benefits, and revenue-sharing mechanisms.
Creates phased roadmaps from custom projects through product, platform, and ecosystem models.
limitations: Recommendations depend on accurate details about capabilities, customers, costs, regulations, and partner access.
Financial targets are planning assumptions and require independent validation with current market data.
The skill does not provide legal, accounting, valuation, or regulatory approval.
Claims about credentials, partnerships, policies, and market demand must be verified before external use.

use_cases.title: Shape a Data Venture
use_cases.description: Compare strategic positions and create an initial architecture, offer portfolio, and revenue mix.

use_cases.title: Productize Data Services
use_cases.description: Convert repeated custom delivery into standard products, recurring revenue, and measurable transition stages.

use_cases.title: Build a Partner Model
use_cases.description: Define membership tiers, channel roles, partner benefits, and practical revenue-sharing rules.

prompt_templates.title: Assess My Current Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our current data business. Identify our position, revenue sources, strongest assets, major gaps, and three immediate priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a concise diagnosis using available company information.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Revenue Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a 1+4+N business architecture for [company]. Include target customers, services, six revenue types, assumptions, dependencies, and validation steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a structured model for a company entering data monetization.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Productization
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-stage roadmap from custom projects to a product and platform model. Define milestones, metrics, reusable assets, owners, and decision gates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Guide a mature services team toward repeatable delivery and recurring revenue.

prompt_templates.title: Stress-Test the Business Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Challenge this proposed data business model: [model]. Test demand, economics, compliance, delivery capacity, partner incentives, defensibility, and failure scenarios. Propose experiments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced review before investment or market launch.

output_examples.input: We provide custom data governance projects and want more recurring revenue.
output_examples.output: Position: managed data monetization partner. Start with a repeatable governance assessment, add annual monitoring, and track recurring revenue share by quarter.

output_examples.input: Design a partner program for regional delivery firms.
output: Create basic, professional, and strategic partner tiers.
Link benefits to training, qualified leads, delivery capacity, and verified outcomes.
Base revenue sharing on sourced demand, delivery responsibility, and collection risk.

output_examples.input: How can we test a DMaaS offer before a large investment?
output_examples.output: Run a small paid pilot with one customer segment. Validate willingness to pay, delivery effort, conversion potential, compliance needs, and renewal intent.

best_practices: Provide verified facts about customers, capabilities, costs, credentials, and regulatory constraints.
Separate evidence, assumptions, recommendations, and open questions in every deliverable.
Validate the model through small paid pilots before funding broad platform development.
anti_patterns: Do not present unverified credentials, partnerships, market figures, or policy claims as facts.
Do not treat membership fees as sustainable revenue without recurring member value.
Do not pursue platform scale before proving repeatable demand and delivery economics.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide customer segments, current services, revenue mix, costs, delivery capacity, credentials, partnerships, and growth goals.

faq.question: What is DMaaS?
faq.answer: DMaaS means Data Monetization as a Service. It covers the path from data preparation through products, transactions, financing, and ongoing operations.

faq.question: What does 1+4+N mean?
faq.answer: It combines one entry capability, four related service areas, and multiple industry scenarios to support expansion.

faq.question: Can this skill create financial forecasts?
faq.answer: It can structure assumptions and revenue scenarios. Users must validate prices, costs, conversion rates, and forecasts with current evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill provide compliance advice?
faq.answer: No. It can identify compliance questions, but qualified legal, accounting, valuation, and regulatory professionals must review decisions.

faq.question: How should recommendations be validated?
faq.answer: Use interviews, paid pilots, delivery measurements, unit economics, renewal signals, and documented decision gates.
